basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer currently living in Seattle, WA. Recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science, I'm spending my gap year exploring new hobbies and diving deep into online gaming. My current obsession is 'SpeedRunners' and 'Fallout 76'. I enjoy watching shows like 'Sex Education' on Netflix during my downtime. Being new to Reddit, I'm still figuring things out here. Usually, I'm online during late evenings and weekends. Single and loving the freedom!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in computer science, having recently graduated from college. I have a strong foundation in programming and technology, mainly self-taught through online courses and hands-on projects. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-acquired through hours of gameplay and community interaction.
